author: /root/construct_integer_witnesses
claim: Actual degree-four field of the two original real normalizing radicals, with selective sign automorphism.

obligations.name: Literal source coefficient
obligations.required_input: The two normalizers must match the original D and its conjugate.
obligations.constructed_input: delta = pair 3 (-1), deltaBar = pair 3 1; delta^2 = D.
obligations.justification: Exact rational coefficient identities, not floating-point approximations.

obligations.name: Rational square descent
obligations.required_input: Nonsquare 7 and 14 over Q must be justified.
obligations.constructed_input: SquareReflection318.fraction_square_iff descends a rational square to Z.
obligations.justification: Normality and fraction-field instances are the actual Z and Q instances; integer candidates are bounded and checked.

obligations.name: Base-field square-class kernel
obligations.required_input: 7 must remain nonsquare over K = Q(sqrt(2)).
obligations.constructed_input: The quadratic-square reflection alternatives are 7 and 14 in Q.
obligations.justification: Both alternatives are excluded by the preceding descent arguments; the radicand 2 is nonzero.

obligations.name: First two radicands
obligations.required_input: delta and deltaBar must each be nonsquare in K.
obligations.constructed_input: Both have norm 7 under the actual quadratic norm homomorphism.
obligations.justification: The norm of a square is a rational square, contradicting the verified nonsquare 7.

obligations.name: Second extension kernel
obligations.required_input: deltaBar must remain nonsquare after adjoining sqrt(delta).
obligations.constructed_input: The alternatives are deltaBar and delta*deltaBar = 7 in K.
obligations.justification: The exact square-reflection theorem is applied with delta nonzero; both alternatives are excluded.

obligations.name: Actual field tower and degree
obligations.required_input: The constructed algebra must be a field, not an assumed Kummer vector space.
obligations.constructed_input: First and Both are literal QuadraticAlgebra towers with field instances derived after nonsquare proofs.
obligations.justification: Each extension has finrank two; the actual scalar tower gives degree four.

obligations.name: Root maps and selective sign
obligations.required_input: The involution must fix one specific root and negate the other.
obligations.constructed_input: firstRoot uses the actual First-to-Both algebra map; secondRoot is the second quadratic generator.
obligations.justification: flipSecond is an actual First-algebra equivalence and its root actions are proved exactly.

obligations.name: Real/group consumer boundary
obligations.required_input: Algebraic signs cannot silently become normalized point maps or real density.
obligations.constructed_input: No elliptic point, real embedding extension, circle comparison or density assertion is constructed.
obligations.justification: Those maps and nontorsion comparisons remain next obligations; the packet is only the concrete radical prerequisite.

obligations.name: History and validation scope
obligations.required_input: A new candidate route does not invalidate history or prove the full theorem.
obligations.constructed_input: Historical compact-Lie route retains its prior-justification status; current packet is pending hosted checks/review.
obligations.justification: No accepted source or manuscript is modified, and no component modulus or full arithmetic theorem is claimed.
